intro.h1: I build fast, clear and easy-to-use websites
intro.p1: No unnecessary stuff, no slow websites, no headaches.
intro.p2: Depending on your needs, I can do a simple site or something more interactive with forms, search features or advanced functions.
intro.p3: I don't usually manage domains or hosting, but if you don't want any hassle I can take care of it.
intro.avisoTexto: I'm migrating my portfolio to Angular + Spring Boot to showcase more features.

estatica.desc: A simple and fast custom-made page. No difficult systems, no constant maintenance.
estatica.aloja: Host it anywhere. Nothing to break.

dinamica.desc: Filters, search, content that updates instantly, smart forms and API connections.

hibrida.desc: A public-facing part and a private one to manage content without touching code.

precio.texto: Every project is different, so prices are discussed without obligation.

sobreMi.p1: My name is Héctor Jarque. I don't come from an agency or a miracle bootcamp. I learned by doing, breaking and fixing things.
sobreMi.p2: I started knowing nothing and gradually trained myself until I could build the websites and projects I create today.
sobreMi.p3: I won't throw jargon at you to impress. If something can't be done, I'll tell you.
sobreMi.p4: I live in Valencia, Spain. I work remotely, and if you're nearby we can grab a coffee.

portfolio.desc: The website you're looking at. Dark/light mode, multi-language, Angular + Spring Boot.

isaac.desc: Connect your Steam account and analyze your achievements in real time.

experiencia.titulo: 3 months in a fintech development team
experiencia.desc: Frontend and backend, feature improvements and work in a real tech environment.

contacto.p1: The best thing is to send me an email telling me what you have in mind.
contacto.p2: If you already have a website, send me the link and I'll take a look.
contacto.p3: You don't need to know about tech or have everything figured out. We'll shape it together.
